questions.question: A ship is full of cargo containers. It drops 2/3 of cargo containers at the first port and takes 60 more, at the second port it drops two third of the new total and takes eleven more. On arriving at the third port it is found that it have 48 cargo containers. Find the number of cargo containers in the ship at the starting?
questions.solution:
Let the number of cargo containers in the ship at the starting be x

Cargo after the first port = {x - (2x/3)} + 60 = (x/3) + 60

Cargo after the second port = {(x/3) + 60} - [(2/3) × {(x/3) + 60}] + 11 = (x/9) + 31

Cargo at the third point = (x/9) + 31

According to the question,

⇒ (x/9) + 31 = 48

⇒ x/9 = 17

⇒ x = 153

∴ There were 153 cargo container in the ship at the starting

questions.question: Out of a group of three numbers, second is thrice of the first and also twice of the third. If the sum of the three numbers is 55 then find the largest number in the group.
questions.solution:
Let three numbers be a, b and c

Now, b = 3a

⇒ a = b/3 ----(1)

And, b = 2c

⇒ c = b/2 ----(2)

Now,

Sum of three numbers = 55

⇒ a + b + c = 55

⇒ (b/3) + b + (b/2) = 55

⇒ 11b/6 = 55

⇒ b = 30

So, a = b/3 = 30/3 = 10

And, c = b/2 = 30/2 = 15

∴ Largest number is 30

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**It is given in the question that the second number is three times the first number and twice the third number. It means it will be divisible by both 3 and 2. Hence our answer should be divisible with 6. Only 30 from the given numbers is divisible by 6.

∴ The largest number is 30.

questions.question: Two whole numbers are such that the cube of first number exceeds the cube of second by 61 and the ratio of the numbers is 5 : 4. What is the value of larger number?
questions.solution:
Let two number be 5x and 4x

According to the question,

⇒ (5x)³ - (4x)³ = 61

⇒ 125x³ - 64x³ = 61

⇒ 61x³ = 61

⇒x³ = 1

⇒ x = 1

∴ Largest number = 5x = 5 × 1 = 5

questions.question: Calculate the length of the tangent (in cm) which is drawn from a point at a distance of 13 cm from the centre and the largest chord of that circle is 10 cm.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9be45f3355a4dd2dacff465387c71bb9f50d8ddfbef57c5e3c3790cd435447f3.png] 

As, largest chord of the circle is the diameter

Diameter of the circle = 10cm

So, Radius (OA) = diameter/2 = 10/2 = 5 cm

⇒ OB = 13 cm

Now, triangle OAB is a right angled triangle as tangent from any point of a circle is perpendicular to the radius at the point of contact so, by Pythagoras theorem,

⇒ OA² + AB² = OB²

⇒ 5² + AB² = 13²

⇒ 169 - 25 = AB²

⇒ AB = √144 = 12 cm

∴ Length of tangent is 12 cm

questions.question: 20 kg of a mixture of wheat and husk contains 5% husk. How many kg more of husk must be added to make the husk content 20% in the new mixture?
questions.solution: Given, Husk in 20 kg of mixture = 5% of 20 = 1 kg Let x kg husk is been added According to the question, ⇒ 1 + x = 20% of (20 + x) ⇒ 1 + x = (1/5) × (20 + x) ⇒ 5 + 5x = 20 + x ⇒ 4x = 15 ⇒ x = 15/4 = 3.75 ∴ 3.75 kg of husk must be added.

questions.question: What is the average of first 11 multiples of 11?
questions.solution:
First 11 multiples of 11 are 11, 22, 33… 121

⇒ Sum of all multiples = 11 + 22 + 33 + ... + 121 = 11(1 + 2 + 3 + … + 11) = 11 × 66 = 726

∴ Average = 726/11 = 66

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**If the number of observations is odd and the observations are in successive manner.

The average = [(n+1)/2]th observation

= (11+1)/2th observation

= 6th observation = 6 × 11 = 66

∴ The average is 66.

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 15200 is divided into two parts. The simple interest on first part at the rate of 25% per annum is equal to the simple interest on second part at the rate of 13% per annum. What is the interest (in Rs.) of first part?
questions.solution:
Let principle for first part be x

So, Principle for second part = 15200 - x

Simple interest on first part = (x × 25 × 1)/100 = 0.25x

Simple interest on second part = {(15200 - x) × 13 × 1)/100 = 1976 - 0.13x

According to the question,

⇒ 0.25x = 1976 - 0.13x

⇒ 0.38x = 1976

⇒ x = 5200

∴ Simple interest = 0.25x = 0.25 × 5200 = Rs.1300

Hiten marks his pen at Rs. 9800 and after allowing discount of 20%, he still earns 12% profit. What is the cost price (in Rs.) of the pen?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price be Rs. x

Marked price = Rs. 9800

Discount % = 20%

Thus, Selling price = MP - discount% on MP = 9800 - 20% of 9800 = 9800 - 1960 = 7840

⇒ Profit % = {(SP - CP)/CP} × 100 = {(7890 - x)/x} × 100

According to the question,

⇒ 12 = {(7840 - x)/x} × 100

⇒ 12x = 784000 - 100x

⇒ 112x = 784000

⇒ x = 7000

∴ Cost price is Rs. 7000

Raja and Kundan together can build a wall in 20 days, Kundan and Mahesh can build the same wall in 30 days and Mahesh and Raja can build the same wall in 24 days. In how many days can all three of them complete the same wall while working together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by Raja and Kundan to built the wall = 20 days

Time taken by Kundan and Mahesh to built the wall = 30 days

Time taken by Mahesh and Raja to built the wall = 24 days

**Calculation:**

Work done by Raja and kundan in one day = (1/R) + (1/K) = 1/20

Work done by Mahesh and kundan in one day = (1/M) + (1/K) = 1/30

Work done by Raja and Mahesh in one day = (1/R) + (1/M) = 1/24

Adding the above three equations we get,

⇒ 2{(1/R) + (1/K) + (1/M)} = [(1/20) + (1/30) + (1/24)] = 15/120 = 1/8

⇒ (1/R) + (1/K) + (1/M) = 1/16

Work done by Raja, kundan and Mahesh in one day = (1/R) + (1/K) + (1/M) = 1/16

**Alternate solution:**

**Concept used:**

Work done = time × efficiency

**Calculation:**

 
 

 
 
**Work done**

**Efficiency**

 
 
 

 
 
Raja and Kundan

Kundan and Mahesh

Mahesh and Raja

Total work (LCM of time)

 
 
 
120

 
 
 

 

 

⇒ Sum of efficiencies of three cases, Raja and Kundan +Kundan and Mahesh + Mahesh and Raja = 15

⇒ 2 × (Mahesh and Raja and Kundan) = 15

⇒ Sum of efficiency of Mahesh and Raja and Kundan = 15/2

⇒ Time in which all will finish the work together = total work/efficiency = 120/(15/2)

⇒Time in which all will finish the work together = 16 days

**∴ They will complete the wall in 16 days while working together**

questions.question: A man starts moving from a place A and reaches the place B in 26 hours. He coves 1/3rd of the distance at the speed of 4 km/hr and covers the remaining distance at the speed of 5km/hr. What is the distance (in km) between A and B?
questions.solution:
Let the distance between A and B be 3x km

Distance covered with speed 4km/hr = (1/3) × 3x = x

Time taken = distance/speed = x/4

Remaining distance = 3x - x = 2x

Time taken = distance/speed = 2x/5

Total time = (x/4) + (2x/5) = 13x/20

According to the question,

⇒ 13x/20 = 26

⇒ x = 40

∴ Total Distance = 3x = 3 × 40 = 120 km

questions.question: If 30% of viewers of movies G and F left before intermission, how many viewers were left watching these two movies post intermission?
questions.solution:
Total numbers of viewers of movie G and F in the starting = 300 + 200 = 500

Viewers who left before intermission = 30% of 500 = 150

∴ Viewers who are watching the movie post intermission = 500 - 150 = 350

questions.question: The area and the length of one of the diagonals of a rhombus is 54 cm² and 9 cm respectively. Find the length of its other diagonal (in cm).
questions.solution:
Area of Rhombus = (1/2) × d₁ × d₂

Where d₁ and d₂ is length of diagonals

So, 54 = (1/2) × 9 × d₂

⇒ d₂ = 12 cm

∴ Length of other diagonal = 12 cm

questions.question: Find the total surface area (in cm²) of a hemisphere of diameter 42 cm.
questions.solution:
Given,

Diameter = 42 cm

Radius (r) = diameter/2 = 42/2 = 21 cm

∴ Total surface area = 3πr² = 3 × (22/7) × (21)² = 4158 cm²

questions.solution:
Given,

sin X = 4/5

⇒ YZ/XZ = 4/5

⇒ YZ = 4k and XZ = 5k

Now, by Pythagoras theorem in triangle XYZ

⇒ XY² + YZ² = XZ²

⇒ (6)² + (4k)² = (5k)²

⇒ 36 + 16k² = 25k²

⇒ 9k² = 36

⇒ k² = 4

⇒ k = 2

Now,

∴ YZ = 4k = 4 × 2 = 8 cm
